ei.title: A Rooftop Garden in Sejong City

fullPassage: In the city, where people and buildings crowd together, much of the land is covered in concrete. In this urban landscape, rooftop gardens provide a natural oasis. These gardens are for cultivating plants on building roofs, and they offer numerous benefits. They help reduce energy consumption for heating and cooling. They also clean the air because their plants give off oxygen and absorb air pollutants. One remarkable example of a rooftop garden is found at the Government Complex Sejong, which has been officially recognized as the largest of its kind. It has a span of 3.6 km and covers an area of 79,194 m², spread across fifteen connected buildings. The ground is covered in basalt, creating a natural drainage effect. In the garden, speakers for announcements are made to look like rocks to complement the plants, creating a beautiful atmosphere. It also possesses an impressive variety of flowers, with a total of 192 different plant species. The beauty of the rooftop garden changes with each passing season, presenting visitors with seasonal flowers and plants, and captivating views to enjoy. The place is free to visit, and everyone is welcome to enjoy the beautiful landscape and aesthetic spectacle of Sejong City from above.

questions.passage: In the city, where people and buildings crowd together, much of the land ①<u>is covered</u> in concrete. In this urban landscape, rooftop gardens provide a natural oasis. These gardens are for ②<u>cultivating</u> plants on building roofs, and they offer numerous benefits. They help ③<u>reducing</u> energy consumption for heating and cooling. They also clean the air because their plants ④<u>give off</u> oxygen.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③ reducing → reduce: help + V(동사원형).
❌ ① is covered: 수동태 적절.
❌ ② cultivating: 전치사 for + 동명사 적절.
❌ ④ give off: 구동사 적절.
det.tip: help + V(동사원형) 또는 help + to V. help + V-ing는 비표준.

questions.passage: One remarkable example of a rooftop garden ①<u>is found</u> at the Government Complex Sejong, which has been officially ②<u>recognized</u> as the largest of its kind. It has a span of 3.6 km and ③<u>covers</u> an area of 79,194 m², ④<u>spreading</u> across fifteen connected buildings.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ④ spreading → spread: 분사구문에서 수동(spread) 필요. 면적이 능동적으로 퍼지는 것이 아님.
❌ ① is found: 수동태 적절.
❌ ② recognized: has been + p.p. 적절.
❌ ③ covers: 3인칭 단수(It) + covers 적절.

questions.passage: In the garden, speakers for announcements are made ①<u>to look</u> like rocks to complement the plants, ②<u>creating</u> a beautiful atmosphere. It also ③<u>possesses</u> an impressive variety of flowers. The beauty of the rooftop garden changes with each passing season, ④<u>present</u> visitors with seasonal flowers and plants.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ④ present → presenting: 분사구문(동시동작). 주절과 연결.
❌ ① to look: 'are made to V' 5형식 수동태 적절.
❌ ② creating: 분사구문(결과) 적절.
❌ ③ possesses: 3인칭 단수(It) + possesses 적절.
det.tip: 분사구문: 주어 동일 + 동시동작 → V-ing. present(동사원형) 불가.

questions.passage: In the city, where people and buildings crowd together, much of the land is covered in concrete. In this urban landscape, rooftop gardens provide a natural oasis. These gardens are for cultivating plants on building roofs, and they offer ①<u>numerous</u> benefits. They help ②<u>reduce</u> energy consumption for heating and cooling. They also ③<u>clean</u> the air because their plants give off ④<u>pollutants</u> and absorb air pollutants.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 의미가 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④pollutants(오염물질) → oxygen(산소): 식물이 '산소'를 내뿜는 것이지 오염물질을 내뿜는 것이 아니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ pollutants → oxygen: 식물은 산소를 배출.
❌ ① numerous(수많은): 적절.
❌ ② reduce(줄이다): 적절.
❌ ③ clean(정화하다): 적절.
det.tip: give off oxygen(산소를 배출) ↔ give off pollutants(오염물질 배출).

questions.passage: One remarkable example of a rooftop garden is found at the Government Complex Sejong, which has been officially recognized as the ①<u>largest</u> of its kind. It has a span of 3.6 km and covers an area of 79,194 m², spread across fifteen connected buildings. The ground is covered in basalt, creating a natural ②<u>drainage</u> effect. In the garden, speakers for announcements are made to look like rocks to ③<u>contrast</u> the plants, creating a ④<u>beautiful</u> atmosphere.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 의미가 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③ contrast → complement: 아름다운 분위기 = 어울림.
❌ ① largest(가장 큰): 적절.
❌ ② drainage(배수): 적절.
❌ ④ beautiful(아름다운): 적절.

❌ ③ produce(생산): 오염물질 생산 부적절.
❌ ④ ignore(무시): 무관.
